# Weather-station data without the repetitive cleanup

**hoboR** is an R package for processing CSV files generated by HOBO weather stations and data loggers. It combines records from multiple loggers, removes duplicates, standardizes timestamps, flags implausible measurements, subsets time ranges, and summarizes environmental variables for analysis.

::: {.publication-links}
[Documentation](https://leboldus-lab.github.io/hoboR/){.btn .btn-primary}
[Source code](https://github.com/LeBoldus-Lab/hoboR){.btn .btn-secondary}
[CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/package=hoboR){.btn .btn-secondary}
[Report an issue](https://github.com/LeBoldus-Lab/hoboR/issues){.btn .btn-secondary}
:::

## What hoboR does

- Imports and combines multiple HOBO CSV files while retaining file-level information.
- Removes duplicate observations and standardizes common date-time formats.
- Detects sensor failures and values outside user-defined biological or physical limits.
- Supports logger calibration, correction checks, and comparisons among devices.
- Selects study-specific date ranges and timestamps.
- Calculates means, standard deviations, totals, minima, and maxima at user-defined intervals.
- Connects summarized weather conditions with field-sampling periods and incidence data.
- Produces time-series plots for selected environmental variables.

## Installation

Install the current release from CRAN:

```r
install.packages("hoboR")
library(hoboR)
```

The development version can be installed from GitHub:

```r
install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("LeBoldus-Lab/hoboR")
library(hoboR)
```

hoboR requires R 4.3.0 or newer.

## Typical workflow

```r
library(hoboR)

# Import all HOBO CSV files in a directory
raw_data <- hobinder(
  path = "data/hobo_csv",
  header = TRUE,
  skip = 1,
  channels = "OFF"
)

# Standardize timestamps and remove duplicates
clean_data <- hobocleaner(raw_data, format = "ymd")

# Summarize environmental measurements every five minutes
summary_data <- meanhobo(
  clean_data,
  summariseby = "5 mins",
  na.rm = TRUE,
  minmax = TRUE
)
```

See the [full documentation](https://leboldus-lab.github.io/hoboR/) for calibration, quality-control, sampling, and plotting examples.
